description: This file contains various enumerations, structures, and functions related to probing and managing remote gateways within the OpenClaw application's macOS component. It defines error handling, connection result types, and a function to asynchronously check the status of the remote gateway.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayAuthIssue
classes.description: Enumeration representing different authentication issues that can occur when connecting to a remote gateway. It includes associated error detail parsing and various properties to generate user-facing messages.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbeResult
classes.description: Enumeration representing the outcome of a remote gateway probe, which can be a success with details, an authentication issue, or a failure with an error message.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbeSuccess
classes.description: Struct providing details about a successful connection to a remote gateway, including the source of authentication and descriptive titles and details.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbe
classes.description: Struct containing the main asynchronous method to perform the gateway probe, handling connection validation, SSH checks, and API interaction to determine the gateway's status.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronous static method that performs the entire probe process, returning a RemoteGatewayProbeResult indicating success, failure, or authentication issues.
